 Inter Shakhtar Donetsk Champions League Inter vs Shakhtar Donetsk Follow Inter v Shakhtar Donetsk, a match on matchday three of the Champions League league phase
 Inter return to action on matchday three of the 2026/2027 Champions League league phase when they host Shakhtar Donetsk. The match kicks off at San Siro at 9pm. Cristian Chivu's Inter already face a do-or-die game. To get back into contention for a top-eight place, they must respond after defeats against Real Madrid and Bruges. Arda Turan's players are in a more comfortable position with four points from their first two outings.
